d: Granada is known for the Alhambra, a hilltop Moorish palace-fortress, its Albaicín old quarter, free tapas culture, and its position between the Sierra Nevada mountains and the Costa Tropical beaches.

transit.airport: Federico García Lorca Airport is about 15 km west of the city; the Alsa airport bus runs to the center (Palacio de Congresos/Gran Vía) for about €3-4 in roughly 40 minutes, and a taxi costs about €30-35.
transit.pass: Bonobús rechargeable card (around €5 deposit, lower per-ride fare, shareable among travelers); the Alhambra Bus (C30/C32) works with it.
transit.system: Granada's city buses (TMG/Rober) cover the center, Albaicín and Alhambra via small minibuses (C30, C31, C32, C34), with a single ticket costing about €1.40 and a rechargeable card giving lower fares.
transit.tip: Book Alhambra tickets weeks ahead, and note that the Albaicín and Sacromonte are steep and cobbled, so wear good shoes and use the minibuses with young kids. For beaches, the Costa Tropical (Almuñécar, Salobreña, about 1 hour by Alsa bus) is the easy day trip.

stay.d: Flat, walkable, close to restaurants, shops and bus links; the easiest base with kids.
Relaxed old Jewish quarter with local tapas bars, quieter nights and views toward the Alhambra.
Atmospheric whitewashed lanes, carmen guesthouses and Alhambra views; steep but the most romantic.
Riverside promenade beneath the Alhambra, with relaxed cafés and easy access to both the Albaicín and the center.

alhambra and nasrid palaces.name: Alhambra and Nasrid Palaces
alhambra and nasrid palaces.d: The magnificent Moorish palace-fortress complex above the city, Spain's most visited monument.

generalife gardens.name: Generalife Gardens
generalife gardens.d: Shady terraced gardens, fountains and water channels, the summer retreat of the Nasrid sultans.

mirador de san nicolas at sunset.key: mirador de san nicolas at sunset
mirador de san nicolas at sunset.name: Mirador de San Nicolás at sunset
mirador de san nicolas at sunset.d: The classic viewpoint across the valley to the Alhambra with the Sierra Nevada behind, glowing at dusk.

albaicin old quarter stroll.name: Albaicín old quarter stroll
albaicin old quarter stroll.d: Whitewashed lanes, carmenes and Moorish-era streets in Granada's UNESCO-listed hillside district.

playa de la herradura and cantarrijan co.key: playa de la herradura and cantarrijan coast
playa de la herradura and cantarrijan co.name: Playa de la Herradura and Cantarriján coast
playa de la herradura and cantarrijan co.d: Calm Costa Tropical bay with a pebbly beach, snorkelling and sea kayaking close to Almuñécar.

sierra nevada hiking and pradollano.name: Sierra Nevada hiking and Pradollano
sierra nevada hiking and pradollano.d: Mountain scenery with easy summer trails, chairlifts and snow activities in winter, about 45 minutes from the city.

hammam al andalus arab baths.name: Hammam Al Ándalus Arab baths
hammam al andalus arab baths.d: Candlelit Arab-style thermal baths with a relaxing massage option, a classic Granada unwind.

entry.hint: From about €40 adults, book ahead; check child access

sacromonte flamenco show in a cave.key: sacromonte flamenco show in a cave
sacromonte flamenco show in a cave.name: Sacromonte flamenco show in a cave
sacromonte flamenco show in a cave.d: Authentic flamenco performed in whitewashed cave venues of the gypsy quarter.

tapas crawl on calle navas and calle elv.key: tapas crawl on calle navas and calle elvira
tapas crawl on calle navas and calle elv.name: Tapas crawl on Calle Navas and Calle Elvira
tapas crawl on calle navas and calle elv.d: Granada's free tapas with every drink, an easy family dinner tour through lively streets.

entry.hint: Free entry, pay for drinks and food

granada cathedral and royal chapel.name: Granada Cathedral and Royal Chapel
granada cathedral and royal chapel.d: Spanish Renaissance cathedral and the tomb of the Catholic Monarchs, a good cool indoor stop.

parque de las ciencias.name: Parque de las Ciencias
parque de las ciencias.d: Hands-on interactive science museum with a planetarium, butterfly house and outdoor areas, excellent for kids and air-conditioned.

alcaiceria and granada bibataubin shoppi.name: Alcaicería and Granada Bibataubín shopping
alcaiceria and granada bibataubin shoppi.d: Covered Moorish-style market streets for crafts, ceramics and marquetry, a handy shelter on hot days.

day trip to nerja and maro cliffs.key: day trip to nerja and maro cliffs
day trip to nerja and maro cliffs.name: Day trip to Nerja and Maro cliffs
day trip to nerja and maro cliffs.d: Coastal day with Balcón de Europa, the Nerja Caves and Maro-Cerro Gordo beaches, kayaking and snorkelling.

alpujarras villages pampaneira bubion an.key: alpujarras villages pampaneira bubion and capileira
alpujarras villages pampaneira bubion an.name: Alpujarras villages: Pampaneira, Bubión and Capileira
alpujarras villages pampaneira bubion an.d: Whitewashed Berber-style villages in the Sierra Nevada foothills with easy walks and local food.

paseo de los tristes riverside walk.key: paseo de los tristes riverside walk
paseo de los tristes riverside walk.name: Paseo de los Tristes riverside walk
paseo de los tristes riverside walk.d: Easy evening promenade along the Darro river beneath the Alhambra walls, with cafes and views.

bodegas castaneda.name: Bodegas Castañeda
bodegas castaneda.d: Famous, lively tapas bar with cured meats, cheeses and vermouth; the free tapa comes with each drink.

los diamantes.name: Los Diamantes
los diamantes.d: Classic fried fish and seafood tapas bar, a Granada institution; try the fried anchovies and calamari.

bar aliatar.name: Bar Aliatar
bar aliatar.d: Traditional Realejo tapas bar known for generous free tapas and local atmosphere.

bar los manueles.name: Bar Los Manueles
bar los manueles.d: Old-school tavern near the cathedral serving classic Granada dishes and generous tapas; try the tortilla del Sacromonte.

restaurante chikito.name: Restaurante Chikito
restaurante chikito.d: Historic restaurant on Plaza del Campillo, linked to Lorca's circle, serving traditional Granadan dishes like habas con jamón.

bar casa torcuato.name: Bar Casa Torcuato
bar casa torcuato.d: Local favorite for tapas and raciones, with great fried fish and home-style dishes.

pizzeria los italianos.name: Pizzería Los Italianos
pizzeria los italianos.d: Casual, crowd-pleasing Italian spot with pizza and pasta that kids tend to enjoy.

heladeria los italianos.name: Heladería Los Italianos
heladeria los italianos.d: Granada's beloved ice cream parlor on Gran Vía, a perfect treat for children after sightseeing.

cafe bar casa pasteles.name: Café Bar Casa Pasteles
cafe bar casa pasteles.d: Traditional pastry shop known for Granadan sweets and pionono.

pasteleria lopez mezquita.name: Pastelería Lopez-Mezquita
pasteleria lopez mezquita.d: Historic pastry shop famed for tarta Alhambra and pionono, ideal for a sweet breakfast.

cafe futbol.name: Café Fútbol
cafe futbol.d: Classic café on Plaza Mariana Pineda serving churros and tostadas with olive oil and tomato.

cafe lisboa.name: Café Lisboa
cafe lisboa.d: Local-style café and bakery with tostadas, churros and coffee; popular for quick, relaxed breakfasts.

pilar del toro.name: Pilar del Toro
pilar del toro.d: Elegant restaurant in a beautiful 16th-century palace with a glass-covered courtyard; a special dinner.

restaurante mirador de morayma.name: Restaurante Mirador de Morayma
restaurante mirador de morayma.d: Albaicín garden restaurant with sweeping Alhambra views and Granadan cuisine; a memorable dinner.

bodegas espadafor.name: Bodegas Espadafor
bodegas espadafor.d: Long-standing local tavern in Realejo with abundant tapas and a lively atmosphere.
